ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the medial region and 35% high-intensity (white) pixels localized on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the outer lateral 1/3 of both lobes. Medial and lower-medial regions are dominated by low-intensity dark pigmentation. Discrete high-intensity speckled mottling is visible in the transition zones between dark and light regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured pixel angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary; peaks and valleys are irregular with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels, most prominent on the outer lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve along the posterior edge with a slight concave inflection point near the medial notch and acute, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-10 pixels in diameter) localized in the lower-medial dark-pigmented regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions visible as diagonal parallel rake marks on the left lobe and a single long diagonal mark on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Yellowish-brown high-contrast clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; distinct white linear rake marks on the ventral surface pigmentation.
